annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds urban air mobility demonstration project operators, urban air mobility service providers, vertiport development project implementers, and government authorities such as the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Mayors/Do Governors.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Any urban air mobility project operator who fails to purchase liability insurance and operates a UAM aircraft in violation of Article 21 shall be punished
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation; provided, Article 17 shall enter into force 3 years after the date of its promulgation.
